name: Shinseiki Ijitte Princess Next ~Namaiki Hime Bea Toujou!~
original_name: 新世紀いじってプリンセスNEXT～鬼（なまいき）姫ビィ登場！～
source:
Bee comes to the Supple Kingdom! Air and Bee are old friends and cousins. Air remembers good old memories. "Wait. Only good memories? Didn't she steal my treasures? Well, is she trying to steal my husband this time?" The main character welcomes Bee as a guest without knowing Air's anxiety. Air somehow tries to separate them, but....

[From ErogeShop.com]
